label: IMM SIE -> EAP API
info:
# IMM SIE EDA -> EAP IMM PMS (PUSH)

Includes IMM_07..IMM_11 plus **PLC_Plastech** (IMM17 / IMM18 + plant energy meter).

## Configure
1. Inject **1 Set EAP webhook URL**
2. Inject **2 Set machine fleet map** (IMM17→3, IMM18→4)
3. Deploy

## Throttle
Default: max **1 push / 10 seconds / machine** (energy gated separately), skip unchanged payloads.

Do NOT use :5184 for webhook (frontend only).
